messages:
Elaine (Docs): Quick thread \u2014 drafting a tiny 'export + retention migration' note for SOC2 docs. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 :memo:
Sam (Security): include provenance_hash semantics and a short warning that redaction rule changes can alter exports.
Elaine (Docs): Suggested provenance line: provenance_hash = sha256(canonical_event_json + schema_version + export_timestamp). Will add.
Nijah (Legal): Wording: use precise phrasing: "By default, Redwood retains and makes available audit evidence for export for 365 days; customers may configure per-tenant retention where permitted by contract. Records under legal hold are preserved until release and exempt from TTL deletion."
Kai (PM): Customer ask: if they shorten retention, can they bulk-export before deletion? Add export API and legal_hold endpoints as migration options.
Matt (SDK): Note for docs: export is JSONL (schema_version per record). I'll add a tiny normalizer/verify helper in the SDK and link it from the docs.
Elaine (Docs): Will add a short curl + python snippet and a manifest example (files, export_timestamp, exported_by, manifest_hash). Also fixing a bad anchor in docs/retention.md (#export-manifest vs #manifest-example).
deploy-bot: Checklist: open small linkfix PR, add changelog line, include SDK helper link when available.
Sam (Security): Also recommend customers store exported bundles in customer-managed storage for long-term retention; auditors prefer signed manifests.
Elaine (Docs): Thanks all \u2014 I'll update the PR with wording, snippets, manifest example, and the provenance note. Marking ready once SDK helper link is posted. :tada:
